citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reinforcement Learning from Reputation Feedback (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7456999
abstract: Experiment T does not show that consensus-weighted selection outperformed equal-weighted selection within this panel and task. Across 589 surviving prompts, joint satisfaction was 0.7963 under consensus weighting and 0.7946 under equal weighting, a difference of +0.0017 with a 95% interval from -0.0051 to +0.0085.
